title: Digi International Adds Open-Standard SMARC® Form Factor to the Digi ConnectCore 95 Family, Now Shipping Globally
summary: Designed to simplify the move to open standards, the Digi ConnectCore 95 SMARC module, built on the NXP i.MX 95 processor, delivers performance, connectivity and scale, with security and lifecycle management services included.
